about.005: CAPRI — Center for Institutional Performance and Strengthening — has the mission of supporting Haitian public institutions in durably strengthening their institutional, organizational, administrative and operational capacities, in order to improve their performance, efficiency and the quality of services delivered to the population.
about.006: CAPRI works with central administration institutions, autonomous state bodies, and territorial governments: Délégations, Vice-délégations, municipalities (Mairies), CASEC and ASEC councils, and other territorial public structures.
about.009: Strong, high-performing and lasting public institutions, serving the population and Haiti's development.
about.012: We diagnose problems, compare models that work, propose adapted solutions, support their implementation and measure results.
about.013: Discover our identity, mission, values, fields of intervention and approach in CAPRI's public institutional presentation.
about.015: Public summary document — operational protocols, governance documents and internal strategic material are subject to controlled access.

fields.002: The full range of essential State functions
fields.004: Organization of the courts, judicial administration, case management, reducing delays, access to justice, statistics, digitalization, integrity mechanisms.
fields.006: Governance, inter-agency coordination, strategic intelligence, legal framework, oversight mechanisms and institutional safeguards.
fields.008: Organization, recruitment, continuing education, internal control, performance evaluation, institutional vetting, anti-corruption prevention.
fields.010: Modernizing the relevant institutions: passports, border control, information systems, customs procedures, anti-fraud efforts.
fields.012: Délégations, municipalities, CASEC, ASEC councils. Clarifying mandates, professionalization, minimum standards, territorial networking.
fields.014: Modernizing the civil status chain, unique legal identity, interoperability, the National Archives, records management.
fields.016: Digital architecture, interoperability, public-service portal, cybersecurity, data governance.
fields.018: Internal control, traceability, transparency, anti-corruption prevention, separation of duties, accountability.
fields.020: Strengthening parliamentarians' capacities, improving legislative work and oversight of government action, modernizing parliamentary procedures and archives, citizen consultation mechanisms.
fields.022: Institutional support to electoral bodies, training of stakeholders and civic education, independent pre-electoral, electoral and post-electoral observation missions, publication of factual reports.
fields.052: Computerization, digital case files, criminal-justice chain.

home.001: Center for Institutional Performance and Strengthening
home.003: CAPRI supports Haitian public institutions in durably strengthening their capacities — for concrete, measurable results.
home.009: Assess the structure, procedures, staff and needs of each institution to identify strengths and weaknesses.
home.011: Seminars for public managers and staff: administration, drafting, ethics, management, planning, monitoring-evaluation.
home.013: Procedure manuals, job descriptions, organization charts, dashboards, administrative templates, monitoring systems.
home.015: No seminar without follow-up. We measure how well what was learned is applied, correct weaknesses, and document results.
home.032: CAPRI does not do the work in the institution's place; it helps the institution become capable of doing it better on its own.
home.b01: Public institutions that are strong, high-performing and lasting, serving the population.

values.002: The principles that guide our action
values.005: Honesty, impartiality and respect for responsibilities. No partisan consideration compromises the quality of our interventions.
values.008: Every intervention is prepared, carried out, documented and evaluated to high standards of competence and rigor.
values.011: Optimal use of resources for concrete, lasting results.
values.014: Effectiveness is measured by the observable changes produced within the institution supported, not by the number of activities carried out.
values.017: CAPRI honors its commitments and encourages clarity in responsibilities, timelines and expected results.
values.020: Systems, procedures and skills able to outlast changes in leadership.
values.023: Solutions tailored to each institution's context rather than uniform models imposed from outside.
values.026: Enabling teams to acquire the skills needed to keep improving on their own.
